description_en: Queries a list of backups. A backup is a full data snapshot of an instance up to the snapshot time. You can fully restore the original data by purchasing a new instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询备份数据列表。一份备份是对实例截止快照时间的全量数据快照，可以通过新购实例完全恢复原来的数据
kebab_example: aliyun hologram list-backup-data --instance-id hgprecn-cn-wwoxxxxx --backup-type redundant --api-version 2022-06-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBackupData

parameters.help_en: The backup type. Filters specific backup data by type. If this parameter is left empty, all backup data is returned
parameters.help_zh: 备份类型。根据类型过滤特定的备份数据，为空则返回所有备份数据
parameters.name: backup_type

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type. Backup types are generally divided into two categories: 1) Local backup, where the snapshot and the instance belong to the same region. 2) Remote backup, where the snapshot and the instance belong to different regions. Valid values:
redundant: Local backup with cross-zone multi-copy storage in the same region.
redundant_remote: Remote backup with cross-zone multi-copy storage in the same region, which is a cross-region copy of the redundant type.
full: Local backup with single-copy storage.
full_remote: Remote backup with single-copy storage, which is a cross-region copy of the full type.
local: Does not represent a specific backup type and is only used to filter local backup data.
remote: Does not represent a specific backup type and is only used to filter remote backup data
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型。备份类型总体上分两种：1）本地备份，快照与实例属于相同Region；2）远程备份，快照与实例属于不同Region。

redundant: 本地备份，同城跨可用区多副本存储。

redundant_remote: 远程备份，同城跨可用区多副本存储，redundant类型在异地的拷贝。

full: 本地备份，单副本存储。

full_remote: 远程备份，单副本存储，full类型在异地的拷贝。

local: 不代表具体备份类型，只用于过滤本地备份数据。

remote: 不代表具体备份类型，只用于过滤远程备份数据

ColdDataSize.description_en: The size of the cold storage data. Unit: bytes
ColdDataSize.description_zh: 冷存数据大小。单位：字节

DataDesc.description_en: The description of the backup data. This field can be updated

DataSize.description_en: The size of the backup data. Unit: bytes
DataSize.description_zh: 备份数据大小。单位：字节

DataTime.description_en: The data snapshot time. For the format, refer to StartTime
DataTime.description_zh: 数据快照时间。格式参考StartTime

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. For the format, refer to StartTime
EndTime.description_zh: 备份结束时间。格式参考StartTime

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the backup

InstanceRegion.description_en: The region where the instance resides

InstanceZoneId.description_en: The zone where the instance resides

SnapshotRegion.description_en: The region where the backup data resides

SnapshotZoneId.description_en: The zone where the backup data resides. For zone-redundant storage, the data is stored across multiple zones, and this field indicates one of the zones
SnapshotZoneId.description_zh: 备份数据所在可用区。其中，同城冗余存储保存在多可用区，这里是其中一个

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone and follows the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSTZ format. The same applies to other time fields
StartTime.description_zh: 备份开始时间。北京时间，格式YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSTZ。下同
